d: A slender adolescent with charcoal grey hair styled in a high ponytail with a yellow hair tie and long bangs. The eyes are olive green and framed by thin-rimmed glasses, set on a youthful face. The outfit consists of a tan sleeveless dress under a dark olive green parka with a white faux-fur collar, paired with a purple bow tie and black lace-up knee-high boots. The character is holding a massive, dark grey multi-barrel rotary machine gun.
